contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade (a landing page for an AI tool recommender, with a featured-tools directory), English only (html lang en at every width), an Indian market (every price is in rupees, '₹1,650'). No right-to-left language.
overall_reason: The layout wraps and stacks cleanly at every captured width, but the whole landing page is rendered by script and shows no text at all with scripts off.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT fails completely on a marketing page (ROB-015, citing the sweep's ROB-001 Floor), while T-WIDTHS, T-HOSTILE-CONTENT and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB pass.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page (Vite single-page app, assets/index-DLxzFw0P.js), all widths
findings.evidence: With scripts off the page has 0 visible and 0 total characters against 2,145 in the baseline (resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off; scripts_off_note 'no text at all with scripts off'). The sweep's hidden_content hit (ROB-001, Floor) records the same 100%. The headline, the navigation, the goal cards and 'Find my stack' all come from one 67 KiB script.
findings.before: An empty root element that a 67 KiB client bundle fills on load.
findings.after: Prerender the landing route to static HTML at build time (Vite SSG or a static export) and hydrate the goal picker and the compare buttons on top.
findings.why: A visitor whose script fails, is blocked or arrives late sees a blank page, and so do crawlers and link previews that do not run script. A landing page has one visit to make its case.
findings.root: Client-only rendering of the landing route

findings.title: Loading never moves what the visitor is reading
findings.where: Stylesheet @font-face rules for Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans, hero h1 'Tell us the goal. We'll build the stack.', all widths
findings.evidence: The readable stylesheet declares 2 @font-face rules with font-display not set and no metric overrides (css.font_face: font_display {'not set': 2}, metric_overrides 0). Plus Jakarta Sans draws 453 characters, including the two-line hero head (fonts.families_drawn).
findings.before: Web fonts loaded with the default block period and no metric-matched fallback.
findings.after: Set font-display: swap and add size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override to a local fallback face for both families (draft ROB-180).
findings.why: On a slow line the hero text stays invisible for up to 3 s, then reflows when the face arrives, because the fallback's metrics differ.

strengths: The goal cards, featured-tool cards and step cards stack one or two per row at 375 and let names, descriptions and tag chips wrap (tiles/375-01.png, tiles/375-04.png); no text_risk row and no equal-height card group was found.
The page weighs 73 KiB over 4 requests with an LCP of 584 ms in the lab, inside every budget.
Prices use one currency and one grouping throughout ('₹1,650', '₹4,000', '₹415'), matching the rupee audience.
The 'Add to compare' buttons answered within 0.5 s in the slow run without waiting on a request.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long tool names were judged from layout evidence.
A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record).
The fail run of each 'Add to compare' action was skipped because the slow run made no request; the compare view and the 'Find my stack' wizard were not opened.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: the compare tray count was not shown in any capture; '20+ curated tools' is fixed copy.
The 'Made in Bolt' badge is host chrome fixed over the goal cards at 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png); it is the host's, not the design's.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
